canonical_title: Planning, Scheduling and Goals of the Maintenance Department
aliases: Ultimate goals of the maintenance department

one_line_answer.text: Planning involves selecting objectives and determining the policies, programs and procedures to achieve them.

cites.quote: Planning involves the selection of objectives and the determination of the policies,
programs, and procedures to be used for the achievement of the selected objectives.

keywords.bn: পরিকল্পনা: লক্ষ্য ঠিক করা ও পথ বাছাই
কোন কাজ কখন হবে তার সময়সূচি

bangla_explanation: Planning মানে আগে objectives ঠিক করা, তারপর policies, programs আর procedures বাছাই করা।
Scheduling হলো planning-এর একটা ধরন, যেখানে কাজের সাথে সময় বেঁধে দেওয়া হয়।
Maintenance department-এর তিনটা দায়িত্ব: health and safety, downtime কমানো, housekeeping।
Ultimate goal একটাই: প্রতিটি maintenance dollar সবচেয়ে ভালোভাবে খরচ করা।

example.en: A TVET institute plans to service its lathe machines. A schedule says which machine is serviced each week.
example.bn: কোন সপ্তাহে কোন মেশিন সার্ভিস হবে, সেটা ঠিক করে দেওয়াই scheduling।

short.prompt: What are the methods of identifying maintenance work?
short.modelAnswer:
Reports that identify work show how the maintenance department finds craft labor hours. The methods are:
1. Complaints
2. Emergency service calls
3. Foreman's inspections
4. Periodic maintenance
5. Inspection by craftsmen
6. Inspection group
7. Formalized planning

keyPoints.text: Identification of work shows how the department determines craft labor hours.

cites.quote: Reports that lead to the identification of work pertains to how a maintenance
department determines requirements for craft labor hours

keyPoints.text: Complains, emergency service calls and foreman's inspections identify work.
Periodic maintenance, inspection by craftsmen and inspection group identify work.
The last of the methods is formalized planning.

checks.note: cblm06-sc1-q1: answer key p.31 says planning 'involves looking ahead and making decisions on what you are going to do' and 'permits you to act rather than react' (All of the above). Neither phrase is in the information sheet; p.26 defines planning as selection of objectives and determination of policies, programs and procedures. Card leads with p.26; key wording shown as a trap.

cblm06-sc1-q2: answer key p.31 lists (a) optimize every dollar, (b) health and safety, (c) housekeeping/appearance as 'ultimate goals'. Info sheet p.26 calls (b) and (c) responsibilities, names one ultimate goal (optimize every maintenance dollar), and has a third responsibility the key omits: minimization of downtime hours. Card follows p.26.
